register.labelZh: MEASURE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: measure something against a standard 可以表示按照同一標準衡量產品、工作、成績或表現。；measure off 適合用來談論長度和劃定範圍;measure out 則適合談論食物、液體、藥物和其他份量。；measure up 可以表示在製作或購買物品前,量度某人、房間、牆壁或窗戶的尺寸。；measure up 和 measure up to 可以表示某人、產品、計劃或表現是否達到預期水平。
register.summaryEn: Measure something against a standard helps you explain how products, work, results or performance are judged. Measure off is useful for lengths and marked areas, while measure out is useful for food, liquids, medicine and other quantities. Measure up can describe taking the dimensions of a person, room, wall or window before something is made or bought. Measure up and measure up to help you describe whether a person, product, plan or performance reaches the expected level.

Prepare properly for clothes and furniture
